title: Strict transform comparison after multiplying a center by a Cartier divisor
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $Z\subseteq S$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose defining ideal $\mathcal I_Z$ is finite-type quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and let $D\subseteq S$ be an effective Cartier divisor, i.e. a closed subscheme whose ideal $\mathcal I_D$ is an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Let $Z_D\subseteq S$ be the closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] cut out by $\mathcal I_Z\mathcal I_D$, let $b:S'\to S$ be the blow-up in $Z$ and $b_D:S'_D\to S$ the blow-up in $Z_D$ [def-nagata-global-blowup], and fix the isomorphism $\varphi:S'_D\cong S'$ over $S$ of [lemma-nagata-blowup-invertible-factor]. For every morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] and quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] having no nonzero local sections supported on $f^{-1}(D)$, the module strict transform of $\mathcal F$ [def-trf-module-strict-transform] relative to the centre $Z$, a quotient of the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $X\times_S S'$, and its module strict transform relative to the centre $Z_D$, a quotient of the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $X\times_S S'_D$, correspond under $\mathrm{id}_X\times_S\varphi$ [def-pc-fibre-product]: the two quotients of the pullback of $\mathcal F$ have the same kernel.
